# Test fixtures (item 13, M0.5; doc 09)

`tests/fixtures/` holds the **upgrade-path corpus** for INV-DATA-001 (data must survive any
sequence of app versions): for every released Bookkeepy 1 version that changed the storage
format, a fixture profile (`versions/vX.Y.Z/<profile>/…` — app.db + rates + exports) plus
its expected post-migration state.

Rules:

- Fixtures are **generated by the app itself** (export from a real profile), never hand-made;
  a fixture PR must include the generating version + command in its README line.
- The upgrade-path CI job (activates when the first fixture lands, M1+) installs each fixture
  into a temp data dir, opens it with the current build, runs `govern data`-level validation
  + migration self-check, and asserts the exported data equals the expected state.
- Fixtures contain **synthetic data only** (no real user data, ever — RULE-PRIV-001).
- `versions/` currently empty; first entries land with M1 (storage).
